rics.description: The Belt and Road Index, Bilateral Relationship
rics.meaning: The Belt and Road Initiative Index: The Belt and Road Index, Bilateral Relationship. Tracks China's BRI activity along physical, capital, population, and enterprise-development dimensions.
rics.how_to_use: BRI launched 2013 by Xi Jinping. ~150 countries have signed BRI MOUs. BRI activity (lending, infrastructure construction by Chinese firms abroad) has slowed since 2019 amid debt-distress concerns at recipient countries (Sri Lanka, Pakistan, Zambia, etc.). Track for China's geoeconomic footprint.
